newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher, further gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher, further gains seen.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished higher on Monday after the central bank issued T$5 billion in three-month negotiable certificates of deposit to mop up liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.733 percent against Saturday's 5.703 close, with the 30-day commercial paper rising to 5.50-5.55 against 5.40-5.50.
The money rates would likely rise further on Tuesday as banks adopted a cautious policy over concerns of tightening liquidity, dealers said.
Sentiment in the bond market was also cautious as investors stepped to the sidelines. Traders said the bond market was directionless at the moment. -- Rachel Lee (2-5080815)
